description.en: Eastern and central Galilee: Tiberias and 'Arraba tax farms, Nazareth, and north-east Galilee (Ba'na); Tiberias held against attacks from Damascus 1738-1743.
description.ar: شرق الجليل ووسطه: طبرية ومزارع ضرائب عرّابة والناصرة وشمال شرق الجليل (البعنة)؛ صمدت طبرية في وجه هجمات دمشق 1738-1743.
description.he: מזרח הגליל ומרכזו: טבריה ואחוזות המסים של עראבה, נצרת וצפון-מזרח הגליל (בענה); טבריה עמדה מול התקפות מדמשק 1738-1743.

sources.quote: The governor of Sidon himself appointed Zāhir as the tax farmer of both Tiberias and ՙArraba, a town located farther west, near Acre.
Ẓāhir al-ʿUmar (c. 1737–75) dominated the political life of northern Palestine for nearly 40 years.
Zahir al-Umar began his career as a minor tax collector and, over a forty-five-year period (1730–1775), emerged as the most powerful leader in Palestine.
In 1735 the Jarrars were defeated by Zahir al-Umar, and their leader, Shaykh Ibrahim, was killed in the battle.

sources.locator: vol. II, ch. XXV, 'Summary of the history of Daher, son of Omar' (from p. 107)
sources.quote: There Pocock found him in 1737; occupied in fortifying himself against the Pacha of Damascus, who, not long before, had strangled one of his brothers.

sources.locator: vol. II, ch. XXV, 'Summary of the history of Daher, son of Omar' (from p. 107)
sources.quote: In 1742, another Pacha, named Soliman el adm, besieged him there; and bombarded the place, to the great astonishment of all Syria

sources.locator: vol. II, ch. XXV, 'Summary of the history of Daher, son of Omar' (from p. 107)
sources.quote: entered the town, where he established himself, without resistance: this happened about the year 1749.

notes.en: Doumani dates Zahir's rise from 1730 and his defeat of the Jarrar clan, which brought Nazareth into his domain, to 1735. Volney (1787) found him fortifying Tiberias in 1737 and dates his move to Acre to about 1749 (later than the 1746 used here for the end of this slice).
notes.ar: يؤرخ دوماني صعود ظاهر بسنة 1730، وانتصاره على آل جرار، الذي أدخل الناصرة في نطاق حكمه، بسنة 1735. ووجده فولني (1787) يحصّن طبريا سنة 1737، ويؤرخ انتقاله إلى عكا بنحو 1749 (أي بعد سنة 1746 المستخدمة هنا نهايةً لهذه الشريحة).
notes.he: דומאני מתארך את עלייתו של דאהר ל־1730, ואת ניצחונו על משפחת ג'ראר, שהכניס את נצרת לתחומו, ל־1735. וולניי (1787) מצא אותו מבצר את טבריה ב־1737 ומתארך את מעברו לעכו לשנת 1749 בערך (מאוחר מ־1746 המשמשת כאן כסוף הפרוסה).

description.en: Galilee with Acre (seized 1746) as capital, influence extended to Haifa and Tantura; Jaffa held briefly in the early 1770s.
description.ar: الجليل مع عكا (استُولي عليها 1746) عاصمةً، وامتد النفوذ إلى حيفا والطنطورة؛ ويافا بقيت لفترة وجيزة في أوائل سبعينيات القرن الثامن عشر.
description.he: הגליל עם עכו (נתפסה 1746) כבירה, ההשפעה הורחבה לחיפה ולטנטורה; יפו הוחזקה לזמן קצר בראשית שנות ה-70 של המאה ה-18.

sources.quote: In 1746, he took the city by force, killed the local multazim, and took his place.
Zāhir was successful in keeping Damascus at bay and expanding his influence to Haifa and Tantura.
He then took advantage of retreating Egyptian forces and conquered the coastal city of Jaffa.
Zahir al-'Umar, the powerful magnate of Palestine from 1746 to 1775, was the first to develop Akka into a major port at the expense of Saida.
